name: Szabolcsbáka (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szabolcsbáka: a quartered blue, green and red shield with a church, a tree and ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed SZABOLCSBÁKA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
